verdict.rationale: The Blink GitHub README lists scp and sftp as built-in commands, gives usage examples for both, and says its curl-based transfers (scp, sftp, and others) use Blink's own key management. Blink's docs cover creating and configuring Ed25519, ECDSA and RSA keys. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the standalone scp/sftp commands (not just curl) use the configured keys, in-depth first-party docs on file transfer, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scp/sftp transfers.
